profile.name: Kainat Naveed
profile.tagline: I build scalable web platforms and production-grade conversational AI.
profile.specialization: Full-Stack Web Development & Conversational AI Systems
profile.bio: I'm a Computer Science graduate specializing in full-stack web platforms and AI-powered conversational systems. My work bridges strong engineering fundamentals with UI/UX sensibility, spanning production-grade voicebots, full-stack applications, and cloud integrations using React, FastAPI, Python, and JavaScript. I care about building intuitive interfaces, automating workflows to boost support efficiency, and crafting reliable software that scales seamlessly.
